sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at The Sandbach Community Football Centre in a 3rd v 4th clash on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach come into the match unbeaten in five games (their most recent result was a draw), while Eccleshall arrive on a four-game winning streak, setting up what promises to be a competitive encounter between two of the division's in-form sides.
divisionWide: The title race sees AFC Bridgnorth face a stern test against league leaders when hosting fixtures, while Stafford Town (joint-second on 19 points) visit Cheadle Heath Nomads. Foley Meir host Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium, with Widnes rock-bottom and winless. New Mills welcome struggling Dawley Town, while Bilston Town face Market Drayton Town in a mid-table encounter. Brereton Social host AFC Bridgnorth (who sit top with an outstanding record), Crewe take on Wednesfield Community at The Excel in a basement-battle atmosphere, and Shawbury United host Wolverhampton Casuals. Telford Town travel to Barnton, and in the day's final notable tie, Allscott Heath (fresh off a 7-1 away win) face bottom-four Alsager Town.
